By infusing yourself with atmacite using a specific key item, it is possible to enhance your fighting prowess during Voidwatch Ops.

Atmacites can only be infused by players possessing a [[periapt of emergence]]. Each periapt of emergence in possession allows the player to equip one atmacite (up to three total).

Atmacites are acquired by defeating the listed [[Voidwatch]] notorious monster with a white spectral alignment greater than 0%. The white alignment is equal to the chance of acquring the atmacite at the end of the battle. For [[Provenance]] battles, Atmacites are automatically obtained upon completion. Newly obtained atmacites begin at level 1 and can be upgraded to higher levels at either any [[Atmacite Refiner]] NPC or any [[Planar Rift]].

Atmacites must be infused by the [[Atmacite Refiner]] or [[Planar Rift]] prior to participating in a battle for a nominal cruor cost. Once infused, the atmacite will remain infused for any future Voidwatch battles until the player infuses a different atmacite. 

Atmacites must be leveled up to achieve their full potential, up to a maximum of level 15. This is done by expending cruor at an [[Atmacite Refiner]] or [[Planar Rift]].

"[[Sphere]]" effects from certain atmacites are a party-only buff with a range of 10' around the player equipped with the atmacite. The sphere effect does not apply to the player using the atmacite, only the other members of the player's party.

After obtaining [["Rhapsody in Mauve"]], upgrades cost 1/20 the amount of Cruor.
